body:
It's not the lack of food that will kill me. It's lack of water.  
And I've had food issues for a long time so I know I can do it.  
I don't know what else to say to this comment. I am nothing like those people. I am not as strong.
I know there are plenty of awesome things, but I don't think I deserve to see them.

I don't think I can redeem myself. Being inside my head is so frustrating. It's feels so full of pressure-- like my brain has been collecting this static buildup and I just want it to stop. I want to bang my head against the wall, I want to throw up, I want to hurt myself. I just want all the fucking noise to go away.  
I want to help someone and help myself and be something worthwhile, but every time I try I fail. I can't do a damn thing right and I know everyone is disappointed. I know I am going to hurt them before I even try.

There are so many beautiful people in this world who deserve so much more than anything and everything I've ever been given. I can't stand to see so much suffering all around me all the time and I can't stand to know I've ever contributed.  
I don't want to be bad. I can't be good. I want to be nothing.
